answer: Each agent id must pay a renewal bond that decays like a glacier unless refreshed by verified work other agents paid to check. A juniper grove analogy: standing acreage only counts on plots you tilled recently, so a relic identity held idle earns nothing and cannot be rented out to a new attacker. Scale n aliases: bonds renew per id with fresh verified work, so attacker cost is n*(bond+work), and any coalition renting old ids must also staff the verification quorum they diluted - a cost super-linear in alias count, making bulk sybils a losing trade.
